summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Located 14 leads for sizing global demand for remotely delivered services in Nepal's candidate segments: UNCTADstat digitally deliverable services (EBOPS categories, calendar year), the WTO Digitally Delivered Services Trade Dataset (July 2026 update), the IMF/OECD/UNCTAD/WTO Handbook on Measuring Digital Trade (2nd ed., 2023) for definitions, UNCTAD LDC Report 2025, NRB BoP services (Nepal FY) and World Bank AI-exposure analyses for the demand-trend adjustment. No values retrieved; all empirical items pending. BPO, freelancing and remote education are not separately identified in BoP, so these segments require proxies.

findings.claim: Research design: Nepal's candidate remote-service segments are provisionally (i) software and IT services, (ii) BPO/contact-centre and back-office, (iii) digital creative and design, (iv) accounting and professional services, (v) online freelancing/microwork, (vi) remote education. Each is mapped to EBOPS 2010 codes; the list must be confirmed by 08A.

Definitions (Handbook on Measuring Digital Trade, 2nd ed.): 'digitally deliverable' (UNCTAD) is an upper bound of services that could be delivered over networks; 'digitally delivered' (WTO dataset) estimates services actually delivered digitally. They are reported separately and never interchanged.
World and regional exports/imports of digitally deliverable services, by EBOPS category, and LDC share.
findings.note: Download UNCTADstat US.DigitallyDeliverableServices and record vintage. No values retrieved.

findings.claim: Digitally delivered services trade by sector and importing market (US, EU, UK, Australia, India, Gulf) relevant to Nepal's segments.
findings.note: WTO dataset download; import-side demand of Nepal's actual/potential client markets.

findings.claim: Nepal's exports of computer and other business services (BoP), to place Nepal's share in each global segment.
findings.period: FY2024/25 and history (Nepal fiscal year); UNCTAD values are calendar year
findings.note: Keep NRB FY values and UNCTAD calendar-year values separate; UNCTAD may estimate Nepal rather than use reported data - check metadata. Under-recording of IT exports via informal channels is a known issue (16A).

findings.claim: Demand-trend adjustment for AI substitution in each segment (from 24A evidence).

data_gaps: No source located for online freelancing demand by country (e.g. Online Labour Index / iLabour project) or for Nepal freelancer earnings. The session-wide WebSearch budget was exhausted during this round; data-source hosts and reference hosts (itu.int, nist.gov, wikipedia.org, arxiv.org) returned EGRESS_BLOCKED to WebFetch.
No Nepal IT-export survey or NRB study on ICT services exports located; informal receipts (freelancer income via wallets or abroad) likely missed in BoP.
WTO Global Trade Outlook / World Trade Statistical Review chapters on digitally delivered services not located.
Market-research estimates (e.g. BPO market size) are not in the source hierarchy and are excluded unless a tier-1-7 source is found.

assumptions.text: Candidate segments are those listed in specific.market_size_evidence.segments pending confirmation by 08A.
Global import demand in Nepal's plausible client markets is the relevant demand measure, not world exports.

challenges.text: X15 should separate demand size (24C) from AI substitution (24A); see 24A challenge.
Please confirm Nepal's candidate export segments and provide any domestic IT-export survey; NRB BoP detail on computer services is needed at the EBOPS level.
Catalog lacks an id for online labour platform indices (Oxford iLabour Online Labour Index) and for Nepal IT industry surveys; add if they are to be used.

uncertainty: High. No values retrieved. UNCTAD 'deliverable' and WTO 'delivered' measures differ conceptually and in coverage; many LDC values are estimated by the compiler; Nepal's own BoP likely under-records IT exports; BPO, freelancing and remote education lack statistical codes; AI may shift segment demand quickly.

market_size_evidence.question: How large is global demand for remotely delivered services in Nepal's candidate segments?
market_size_evidence.answer_r1: Pending. BPO, freelancing and remote education are not separately identified in BoP statistics, so segment sizing for them needs proxies. No values retrieved.
